rows.grounds: compound denoting the directional guardian deities
compound referring to the weapons of those guardians
prescriptive verbal form expressing ritual injunction
action noun naming the ritual act

items.question: Which deities and implements must be honored in this prescribed manner of worship?
premises: The world-guardians are objects of worship.
The weapons of those guardians are also to be worshipped.
The worship is to be performed in this manner.
items.inference: Therefore, the ritual worship includes honoring the world-guardians together with their weapons in the prescribed manner.
uncertainties: The exact ritual details implied by ittham depend on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: One should worship the world-guardians and their weapons; such is the worship.
